newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo aluminium futures ended higher in all months on Wednesday, reflecting price gains at the London Metal Exchange overnight and the yen's weaker tone against the dollar, local traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 to 3.6 yen higher, with the benchmark June 1998 contract up 1.2 yen at 202.7 yen per kg.

Active buying from individual investors emerged in early morning session, pushing up the benchmark June 1998 to 203.8 yen at one stage, traders said. They said technical selling capped the topside by late afternon.
In London on Tuesday, three-month aluminium futures closed at $1,704 per tonne, up $30 from the previous close.
